blockedReason: Two reasons. (1) No SH-14 UI exists to verify. Dev shipped only TASK-1 to TASK-7 (deps, schema, validators, recurrence, iCal builder, audience resolver, notification types). Every UI task (TASK-13, TASK-17 to TASK-23) has no code on disk, and the only src changes are modified src/lib/dates.ts, src/server/notifications/types.ts and src/theme/theme.ts, plus new untracked src/lib/validators/calendar.ts, src/server/announcements/ and src/server/calendar/ (none of them UI). QA independently reports overallStatus FAIL (32 NOT-IMPLEMENTED). (2) Rendering was also blocked by the environment. On the existing `next dev` server at :3001 (this repo), the /login page renders without styles and never hydrates, so the credential form posts natively and reloads empty. Login failed for all 4 seeded roles (admin, teacher, parent, student), so no authenticated page could be rendered. The :3000 server belongs to a different checkout (~/Documents/forge/schoolhub) and returns 500 for every route. I did not restart the shared servers. No figma-readiness.json exists, so there was no design reference.
